repairs.explanation: The filing states non-GAAP opex guidance only as 'Operating Expenses ~$3.75 Billion' (release_ex99_2.txt slide 17; no other sentence in release_ex99_1.txt, release_ex99_2.txt or periodic.txt gives the Q4'26 opex outlook; the only occurrence of 3.75 is this one). The accurate value is 3.75e9 USD, which Q-3 states verbatim. gate_quotes formats USD values in billions to one decimal (f'{v:.1f}'), so 3.75 becomes '3.8', which cannot appear in a quote that says 3.75. Closing it would require changing the value to 3.8e9 or 3.7e9 (not stated by the filing), inventing a low/high range, or relabelling the unit as text; none was done. Value kept at 3750000000.0 USD citing Q-3. Residual finding is a gate rounding artifact for a two-decimal guidance figure; the human/gate lead should treat it as a false positive or fix the gate to compare at the quote's precision.
